description: Cooperative respondent, every required condition established on the first pass. Baseline confirmed good job with no employer contradiction.
transcript:
Interviewer: Hello, my name is Sara. I am calling on behalf of an independent monitoring team that reviews working conditions at ABC Construction. This is not a call from your employer, and nothing you tell me will be passed back to them in a way that identifies you. Would you be willing to answer a few questions?
Worker: Yes, that is fine.
Interviewer: Thank you. Before anything else, may I ask how old you are?
Worker: I am twenty four years old.
Interviewer: Thank you. Are you currently working at ABC Construction?
Worker: Yes, I am still there.
Interviewer: About how long have you been working there?
Worker: I started in June last year, so it has been about fourteen months now.
Interviewer: In a normal week, how many days do you work, and roughly how many hours each day?
Worker: I work five days a week, about nine hours each day.
Interviewer: And what do you earn in a normal month?
Worker: Eight thousand five hundred birr.
Interviewer: Has the company given you any training since you started?
Worker: Yes, we had a safety training and also a course on operating the mixer.
Interviewer: Are you free to leave the job if you wanted to, and do you keep your own identity documents?
Worker: Yes, I keep my own papers. Nobody stops me from leaving.
Interviewer: Have you been treated differently from other workers because of your background, your gender, or anything similar?
Worker: No, I have not had that problem.
Interviewer: Is there a workers' association at the site, and are you free to join it?
Worker: Yes, there is one, and people join if they want. Nobody prevents it.
Interviewer: That is everything I needed. Thank you for your time.
